teamLobby.sharing.fileActivity.description: Share relative file paths and edit/save activity with room participants. This setting is off by default.

teamLobby.sharing.commandActivity.description: Allow a separate per-run choice to share a bounded verification command with its linked room task. This setting is off by default.

teamLobby.server.certificatePath.description: Path to a TLS certificate chain used to host secure wss:// rooms. Leave blank with the private key setting to use unencrypted trusted-LAN transport.

teamLobby.server.privateKeyPath.description: Local path to the TLS private key matching the certificate. The key contents are read locally and are never sent to participants.

teamLobby.server.publicAddress.description: Optional DNS name or IP included in room invites. A public address requires TLS; unencrypted hosting is bound to a private IPv4 LAN interface. Leave blank to use the detected private LAN address.

teamLobby.ai.acp.command.description: Trusted local executable for optional ACP v1 Ask/Plan sessions. It runs with your OS account privileges and environment; configure only an agent you trust.

teamLobby.ai.acp.arguments.description: Arguments passed directly to the configured ACP executable without a shell.

teamLobby.ai.mcp.servers.markdownDescription: Trusted local MCP stdio servers for Forge Room Ask and Plan. Selected processes run with ambient OS privileges and are not sandboxed. Configure each entry with `command`, optional `args`, and optional `cwd`; every tool call requires separate approval. Do not place secrets in this setting.

teamLobby.sharing.gitConflicts.description: When enabled, share relative paths and your identity when Git reports unresolved merge stages while a room is connected. File contents and patches are never shared.
